4th Unique Awards (非凡奖 since 2019) jury reveal continues. Submissions: ~200 cases from 100+ brands/vendors; first dedicated go-global track = 41.3%; ~1/3 product / 2/3 service. Ceremony targeted early December. Jury pool of 100 across enterprise / brand / investor / academia / media committees scores online for authority and advance.
